Package aor.proj3t.dto

Class UserCsvDTO

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.dto.UserCsvDTO
public class UserCsvDTO extends Object
DTO specifically designed for CSV export of User data.

Uses OpenCSV annotations to map user attributes to structured CSV columns. This DTO provides a flat representation of user profile metadata, optimized for exporting data into spreadsheets, audits, or analytics pipelines.

Attributes: - id: Unique identifier for the user - email: Primary contact email of the user - firstName: User's given name - lastName: User's surname - phoneNumber: Optional phone contact number - address: User's residential or mailing address - birthdate: User's date of birth, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd - role: Current role or position held by the user - managerId: ID of the user's assigned manager - manager: Full name of the user's manager - workplace: Name of the user's office or department
